studies.title: Do convergences lead price?
studies.finding: No. Two profitable traders opening the same side did no better than one trader alone.

studies.title: Does the crowd's lean mark tops or bottoms?
studies.finding: No. It moves against the last move (they buy drops, take profit into rallies) and does not lead the next days.

studies.title: Are position traders worth following?
studies.finding: Their conviction bets (2x their usual size) met the bar: +3.4% over 30 days, 65% positive. Everything else they open: no edge. Pending the forward record.

studies.title: Do build-ups lead to a move?
studies.finding: Long build-ups beat the market by 4 points over 30 days, but +30% runs were no more common than for any coin. Not a pump detector.

studies.title: After a crowded day, does the market correct?
studies.finding: No. When 80%+ of the crowd's positions were long, or 80%+ of coins sat above their 50-day average, BTC rose the next day about half the time, as on any other day.
studies.unit: BTC's move the next day: the median of each set, with how many days and the share that rose. Breadth: Hyperliquid coins above their 50-day average. Crowd: S2's rebuilt share long; its 66 days at 80%+ are one stretch (8 July to late August 2026).
